For guided mode, the user needs to switch to advanced mode to edit the query.
The graph supports two views:
Average use per day – the average use of resources per day
Highest use per day – the highest actual use of resources per day
This means that, for instance, if on a specific day you ran two queries, one query used 50% of
your resources and the other query used 100%, the average daily use value shows 75%, while
the top daily use shows 100%.
